headline: Pakistan Short-Term Inflation Rises to 12.31% Driven by LPG and Food Costs
summary: Pakistan's Sensitive Price Index showed short-term inflation increased to 12.31% year-on-year for the week ending November 5. Spikes in prices for tomatoes, LPG, and potatoes accounted for the increase.
why: The Sensitive Price Index measures weekly price changes of essential goods in Pakistan, reflecting domestic cost-of-living pressures.

impacts.name: Pakistan
impacts.why: Rising food and fuel inflation exerts pressure on household discretionary spend.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
